notes.title: First look at Pilgrims: Curious Adventures, our debut board game!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35966573/015eb5d4fa29343d563c9b24d7890a880ca0dc79.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Hello, travelers![/h3][p]We’re excited to share a closer look at [i][b]Pilgrims: Curious Adventures[/b][/i], our very first board game developed in collaboration with our friends at Pink Troubadour. It’s inspired by the whimsical world of our video game [i]Pilgrims[/i], but instead of doing a one-to-one adaptation, we brewed up something new: a highly replayable, easy-to-learn yet deeply tactical tabletop adventure. Our goal was to keep the charm and playfulness of the original while creating mechanics that feel right at home on your table.[/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35966573/6a8e368614393471df5ded29b54d0fff36614612.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35966573/e8cc374d614f13f034232d9d4b2a41e285233a27.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35966573/d9fbef7a5abe87fe202b441b60a6e7c78345024b.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35966573/cec7d84286676d59ba06e9e77e876259fbb494cb.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35966573/efc02573860b1f5b9f81a52e7c0e1f79acc88f0a.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p]In [i]Pilg[/i]rims:[i] Curious Adventures[/i], you can compete with up to three friends or even venture out solo. You’ll wander across an ever-changing map of cards to recruit companions and collect useful items. Combine movement and collected cards in thoughtful, puzzle-like ways to trigger special abilities and complete adventures to earn points and party improvements. As your party grows stronger, so do the possibilities for clever tactics and combos.[/p][p]In a [url="https://www.riseher.cz/rozhovor-radim-jurda/"]recent interview[/url] for Riseher.cz, designer and illustrator Radim Jurda (lead designer and artist on [i]Creaks[/i]) shares how a small card prototype grew into a full-fledged board game, how he balanced a playful atmosphere with strategic gameplay, and what it’s been like to bring Amanita’s signature style into a new medium. You can read the entire [b]interview in English[/b] now on [url="https://boardgamegeek.com/blog/16617/blogpost/177505/radim-jurda-on-his-new-board-game-and-personal-sty"]BoardGameGeek[/url].[/p][p][i]Pilgrims: Curious Adventures[/i] will make its debut this October at Essen SPIEL 2025, the world’s largest board game fair. The English edition will launch this fall, with pre-orders opening in late September on Amanita Design’s [url="https://merch.amanita-design.net/"][u]online shop[/u][/url]. A Czech edition is planned for 2026. Stay tuned, we’ll share pre-order details and other news here on Steam![/p][p]Wishlist [i]Pilgrims: Curious Adventures[/i] on BoardGameGeek, where you'll also find the game's [url="https://boardgamegeek.com/filepage/305465/pilgrims-rulebook"]rulebook[/url]:[/p][p][url="https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/444683/pilgrims-curious-adventures"]https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/444683/pilgrims-curious-adventures[/url]
[/p][p][b]BONUS PICTURES: A fresh look at the wooden meeple! [/b]ːmuchomurkaː[/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35966573/4158596a120d0bb52782d4518671e84f8c51ad54.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35966573/50c68fc5229de0e150e0beda55d2dbd0f10a21aa.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][/p]

notes.title: Happy Game Is Amanita Design's New Psychedelic Horror
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30887835/b1500c39c51b6c3eb45b48bfec7bd95a4458eccf.jpg[/img]

We're very [i]happy [/i]to announce [b]Happy Game[/b], the upcoming adventure from the creators of CHUCHEL and Botanicula, and our first actual horror game is coming to Steam and Nintendo Switch next year in spring. You can now add [i]Happy Game[/i] to your Steam wishlist. ːchuchelsmileː

[i]Happy Game[/i] is a psychedelic horror adventure that departs significantly from Amanita’s charming, family-friendly style. This time, players will find themselves playing as a little boy who experiences a terrible nightmare, passing through three unique worlds filled with playful tasks and puzzles. He won’t be all alone on this trip, though - there are many smiley faces to meet, adorable bunnies to [strike]slice with a guillotine[/strike] greet, or an elusive football to chase. The game is directed by Czech artist, animator, and designer Jaromír Plachý, whose teams previously created [i]Botanicula [/i](2012) and [i]CHUCHEL [/i](2018).

[previewyoutube=f3t2BsJDe7g;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1206060/Happy_Game/

Stay happy.
Lukas

notes.title: Pilgrims Soundtrack on Steam - update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35966573/aac4c6e63ea19b0c33c97a8da589911ea122217c.png[/img]

Hi all!

A few weeks ago, we released Tomáš Dvořák’s music for Pilgrims to some lovely reception, for which I’d like to thank you! But there was a little improvement to be done, which doesn’t have anything to do with the music itself.

We hadn’t realized it could become inconvenient for some of you, since it was of the main game package - for example, if you wanted to move the music files somewhere else on your computer, the entire soundtrack would always automatically re-download to the game’s folder. So to make things easier for everyone, we’ve created a standalone free product for Pilgrims Soundtrack that you can now add to your library and treat it as any other soundtrack release on Steam. MP3 and FLAC files are both included :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1373160/Pilgrims_Soundtrack/

Happy listening!
Lukas

notes.title: Creaks from Pilgrims studio is launching on Steam next week!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30887835/37608c53695dd76a2b6728f99c035978b10195e4.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone,

I am excited to finally let you know that Creaks, our latest surreal puzzler, is launching on Steam next Wednesday, July 22! Please check out the game's Steam page and add the game to your wishlist if you like what you see ːsamorost_spiritː

https://store.steampowered.com/app/956030/Creaks/

Creaks takes you on a visit to a mysterious towering mansion, inhabited by eccentric avian folk and strange creatures, which may or may not be as dangerous as they seem. In their animated form, these monsters called creaks are deadly enemies you should always keep your distance from. However, as soon as you manage to trap them under a beam of light, they transform into harmless furniture that might be just as useful when you’re solving many of the game’s elaborate puzzles. Players will meet several types of creaks in the game, and each of them behaves differently - while dogs will chase you on sight and spies will copy or mirror your movement, the jellyfish-like creatures composedly patrol the area.

[previewyoutube=YgBaf3onLWs;full][/previewyoutube]

Inbetween individual levels and challenges, players will get to explore the house for a series of hand-crafted paintings, some of which were carefully hidden in discoverable secret rooms. About a third of the 35 collectible pieces are playable mini-games, taking on the role of little arcade cabinets in the aesthetic of 18th and 19th-century wall art.

A game inspired by the topics of ambiguity and pareidolia - the psychological phenomenon of “seeing things” - Creaks aims to surprise players with its diverse surreal environments, hand-drawn, hand-painted, and carefully animated, as well as refined puzzles. The visual art goes hand-in-hand with music from Brighton-based composer and multi-instrumentalist Joe Acheson, aka Hidden Orchestra. He delivered an eclectic score that adaptively changes based on your progression within each of the game’s levels and often drops the beat to celebrate the moment you finally figure it out. Instruments Joe used on this soundtrack, his first-ever work for a video game, are ranging from zithers and flutes to organs and choirs to modular synthesizers.

Thank you for supporting our games! We're looking forward to hear and read what you think about Creaks. ːmuchomurkaː
Lukas

notes.title: Hear the music of Pilgrims
notes.notes:
Hello! ːmuchomurkaː

We've got a little surprise for you today - the soundtrack EP with playful music from Pilgrims by Tomáš Dvořák (aka Floex) is out today and available for download with the game at no additional cost! Simply update the game and a folder with MP3 and FLAC versions of the album will appear in your Steam folder.

This soundtrack was largely shaped and influenced by the musicians who recorded their parts on various live instruments, namely:

Roman Zabelov - accordion (1,4, 6)
A. m. Almela - guitar, mandolin (2, 5)
Jakub Tengler - drums, percussions (1, 5, 6)
Jiří Javůrek - bass clarinet (2)

As usual, it was mastered by the brilliant Matouš Godík.

If you prefer streaming services over downloads, we got you covered - it's also available on Spotify, Apple Music and others! Give it a listen on your favourite platform via this link: https://lnkfi.re/PilgrimsEP

Enjoy!
Lukas

notes.title: Wot I Think: Pilgrims
notes.notes:
Developer: Amanita Desisgn
Publisher: Amanita Design

Release: Out now
On: Windows, Mac, Linux
From: Steam, Humble, Itch, GOG
Price: 5, $5, 5

The surprise announcement of a new Amanita game, while we were all happily waiting for the announced Creaks to appear, is almost certainly to do with the clandestine nature of Apple Arcade. With so many developers sensibly taking advantage of Apple’s pouring money tap, and with the exclusivity arrangement extending only to screwing over Android, us PC players are enjoying a sudden windfall of meant-for-telephone games. Since one of these is a bonus Amanita game, then… well, hooray for stupid corporate practices!

Following on from the spellbinding Chuchel, this new little yarn Pilgrims upholds Amanita s reputation for wonderful art and animation, and for simple, intuitive, non-verbal games. It might perhaps fall a little short, however, of their reputation for exquisite brilliance. And indeed in terms of length.

notes.title: Makers of Samorost and Machinarium release a quirky new adventure game, Pilgrims
notes.notes:
Amanita Design, the makers of Machinarium and the Samorost series, have released a quirky new adventure game, seemingly without warning. (Surprise! Isn't it nice when a game is just out instead of preceded by four months of trailers?) It's called Pilgrims, it's available now, and having played it this morning I can confirm it's crafted with the same beautifully offbeat art and animation as Amanita's previous games.

You begin with a single character, a traveler, who wants to take a boat ride down a river. As you explore the map looking for an elusive bird to please the sleepy owner of the boat, you'll encounter puzzles to solve and a collection of other characters, some of whom can join you if you solve their problems. Every item and companion you collect is represented with a playing card, so you slowly assemble a little deck of adventure cards and characters to play in various situations.

 What's really great is there are animations for every card you play in every situation—even if what you're doing isn't a correct solution to a puzzle. It's got the standard 'try using everything on everything else' trial and error system when you aren't sure how to proceed, but even when those desperate guesses don't work out, you still get to watch them not work. Using a lasso on a bear or a feeding worm soup to a witch might not get you closer to achieving your goals, but you still get to see what happens. It's much more satisfying that a simple "I can't do that."

There are also a ton of achievements you can earn just for just trying out weird card combinations, which gives you a reason to experiment freely and to play again once you've finished.

Pilgrims is set in a weird world full of rude priests, kings and princesses, reckless adventurers, hungry (and extremely picky) bears, and chuckling pond-goblins. It's short—it took me about an hour to complete it, though there are still loads of solutions I haven't tried—but it's wonderful. Pilgrims is available on Steam, GoG, Itch.io, or directly from Amanita for about five bucks.

notes.title: Pilgrims is a surprise new game from the makers of Samorost
notes.notes:
Bloody hell, how about a heads-up next time? The adventure game connoisseurs at Amanita Designs – of Machinarium, Samarost and Chuchel fame – only went and dropped a whimsical new game without warning. Released earlier this morning, Pilgrims is freeform romp around a lovingly drawn map, guiding a band of misfits on their merry way. Bounce through the woods, make deals with devils, kings and woodland critters, and try to wrap up the personal stories of your travelling misfits. Or don’t, and simply join them for the ride.
